2499.sigma:
title: Cisco vManage Service-Proxy POST to JSP Web Shell (CVE-2026-20262)
id: 8b6caf43-3e4f-6cb1-bd43-509e7f9b3456
description: Detects HTTP POST requests to JSP paths on the vManage service-proxy that are not part of the legitimate application context — indicates web-shell interaction following CVE-2026-20262 exploitation.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/cisco-releases-security-updates-for.html
  - https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-sdwan-arbfw-c2rZvQ
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.t1071.001
logsource:
  product: cisco_sdwan
  service: serviceproxy_access
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: 'POST'
    cs-uri-stem|endswith: '.jsp'
  filter_legit:
    cs-uri-stem|startswith:
      - '/login/'
      - '/app/'
      - '/portal/'
      - '/home/'
      - '/dataservice/'
  condition: selection and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Cisco-internal diagnostic JSP under a new context root (rare, ties to version upgrade)
level: high
2499.spl:
search index=cisco_sdwan source="/var/log/nms/containers/service-proxy/serviceproxy-access.log" "POST" ".jsp"
| rex field=_raw "POST\s+(?<uri_path>/\S+\.jsp)\s+HTTP"
| where isnotnull(uri_path) AND NOT match(uri_path, "^/(login|app|portal|home|static|dataservice)/")
| stats min(_time) as first_seen, count, dc(src) as unique_sources, values(uri_path) as jsp_paths by host
| where first_seen >= relative_time(now(), "-7d@d")
